method: The implementer read each verdict against the texts (must-not: the reference text and the candidates the judge saw; procedure: the skill procedure and the compiled procedures; kinds: the statement). Recall verdicts are `match` or `no_match`. A kinds verdict is the set of missing rule types named; two sets agree when they are equal. Fix round 1 added one must-not case found earlier (a known false match of the first sample) and one correction of the sorter.
